scope: controlled AC1012 TABLE compound; not native semantics
authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 2.13 and 20.4.96.1
observations: The output TABLE frame is exactly the source frame with its attribute flag changed and three handles inserted; its CRC is valid. LibreDWG 0.14 reopens the TABLE and confirms first and last ATTRIB 757, SEQEND 759, and their owner 4F2.

Wrong endpoint role, ATTRIB owner and SEQEND owner were separately mutated with valid frame CRCs. Each is rejected without any parent TABLE, INSERT, raw or grid callback; the same reader then delivers the corrected compound.
The corrected control exposes the attribute through TABLE and 2D INSERT callbacks and, when enabled, the 9 by 20 legacy grid.
limits: Other rewritten objects are not qualified.
No native TABLE semantics or strict output claim is established.
The entire derivative has unrelated rewritten unsupported objects; a complete successful file conversion is not claimed.
Additional ordering, native producer semantics, cells, output and independent readback remain open.
